name: AMUD-Dashboard
description: Compiled Rust homelab dashboard — app launcher, live Docker telemetry, Plex/Jellyfin/HA badges. Zero YAML; config in SQLite via the web UI. ~35–100MB RAM for server + agent combined. **Also install the companion template: AMUD Agent** (search Community Apps for "AMUD Agent"). Both containers must use the same Agent Secret and the same Socket Path. Unraid appdata is owned by `nobody` (UID 99) by default — the dashboard runs as PUID 99 so first boot works without SSH `chown`. Docs: https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/docs/installation/Unraid

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: SQLite database and encrypted secrets (backup this folder).

paths.name: Agent Socket Dir
paths.description: Shared directory for the Unix socket. Must match the AMUD Agent container exactly.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the AMUD Dashboard web interface.

variables.name: Agent Secret
variables.description: Long random string shared with the AMUD Agent container. Required — server will not start without it.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for dashboard writes to App Data (Unraid default: 99 / nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for dashboard writes to App Data (Unraid default: 100 / users).

variables.name: Socket Permissions
variables.description: Unix socket file mode (octal). 666 lets the root agent connect when dashboard runs as PUID 99.

variables.name: DB_PATH
variables.description: SQLite file path inside the container.

variables.name: AMUD_SOCKET_PATH
variables.description: Unix socket path inside the container.

variables.name: BIND_ADDR
variables.description: Address the web server binds to.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Internal HTTP port (must match Web UI Port mapping).
